introduction: This level focuses on the crucial regulatory bodies governing agriculture, small industries, telecommunications, and insurance. Examiners love to test these because their headquarters often deviate from the usual 'New Delhi/Mumbai' guesses.

core_concepts.title: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Mumbai, Maharashtra**. 
Established: **12th July 1982** (On the recommendation of the B. Sivaraman Committee). 
Key Fact: It is the apex regulatory body for overall regulation of regional rural banks and apex cooperative banks in India.

core_concepts.title: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**. 
Established: **1990**. 
Key Fact: It is the apex regulatory body for overall licensing and regulation of micro, small and medium enterprise (MSME) finance companies in India.

core_concepts.title: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Hyderabad, Telangana**. 
Established: 1999 (Based on the Malhotra Committee report). 
Key Fact: It is tasked with regulating and promoting the insurance and re-insurance industries in India.

core_concepts.title: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **New Delhi**. 
Established: 1997. 
Key Fact: It is the regulator of the telecommunications sector in India (overseeing operators like Jio, Airtel, Vi).

important_entities.name: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
important_entities.significance: Headquarters: **Mumbai**. Established: 1956. It is an Indian state-owned insurance group and investment corporation.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
The Biggest Exam Trap: Because most financial institutions are in Mumbai, students blindly guess Mumbai for SIDBI and IRDAI. 
Remember: 
- **SIDBI** = Lucknow. 
- **IRDAI** = Hyderabad.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The Small Industries Development Bank (SIDBI) is headquartered in **Lucknow**.

exam_strategy_tips: A highly repeated question in Bank PO and State PCS exams: 'NABARD was established on the recommendation of which committee?' Answer: B. Sivaraman Committee.
